text:
anya: Quick thought  run a single 10-day "surge window" DP to validate heavy-traffic behaviors and collect comparable telemetry across partners.
rasheed: Good for stress cases. What's target size?
anya: 4-6 partners, at least 1 deep integrator. Keep commitment light but measurable.
meera: Proposed success KPIs:
- 4 partners completing commitments (1 onboarding + 2 checkpoints)
- 1 integrator sustaining >5k tokens/day for 48h
- >=5 actionable GH issues with repro/spec notes
- no critical latency regressions vs baseline
sam: Offer perks: 2h onboarding clinic, priority triage, and a short post-cohort healthcheck report.
meera: Screener (tiny): workload type; est tokens/day; can share redacted traces?; willing to run 30m integration test?
nina-legal: Use phrase "share redacted request/response traces for debugging; enterprise customers may request a DPA amendment." I'll post exact wording.
ops-bot: Note: reserving a small dedicated buffer for surge window requires 5 business days notice.
rasheed: Eval plan: weekly sync + daily async pulse (short), capture prompt sets + golden outputs for auto-eval. Runtime to run smoke tests after each deploy.
anya: Owners: sam (ops & invites), meera (prompts & feedback capture), rasheed (runtime/harness), nina-legal (contracts).
sam: I'll draft invite copy and post screener tomorrow AM. Creating #dp-surge-window channel and GH repo after that.
meera: Gate to next stage: >=80% actionables triaged/fixed or scheduled, no P1/P0 regressions, and at least one validated integrator pilot.
anya: Ok let's start recruitment next week. Keep the screener under 5 fields and include a "light participation" opt-in for async-only partners.
